name: Factorial zeros
description: You are given a positive integer n . Output the number of trailing zeros in n ! ( n ! denotes a product of integers between 1 and n , inclusive).
input_specification: The only line of input contains an integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 1000000 ).
output_specification: Output the number of trailing zeros in n ! .
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
